headline: How long do I give him to commit before I move on?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/writeups/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing default decode-him frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. You couldn't see the picture, yet your hand found the one ready for action.
Every tool is out, and both hands are occupied.
You asked how long to give him before moving on. The readiness for action is what catches me.
He has not committed, and you are the one asking how long to keep the question open.
What has hold of the commitment keeps action from becoming a decision. I don't think this began with you.
Let me see what is holding the commitment…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. The backs were alike, but you reached for the card held at one point.
One rope holds one ankle. Nothing else is tied.
You asked for a limit on waiting for his commitment. This card brings me to the one rope.
Still, the commitment remains suspended while you wait for a limit.
Just as the wait would become an answer, something appears. I don't think it started with you.
Let me see what's doing this…
c: You turned the Fool. The card was hidden, yet your hand went to the one travelling light.
The small bundle on his stick is all he is carrying.
You asked when to move. The light bundle on this card holds my attention.
But his commitment has not moved, and your own movement is tied to the answer.
There's something between the open road and his commitment. I don't think it began with you.
Now let's look at what's there…
